purpose: Let the authoritative stage DAG drive real, observable, read-only execution on both primary runtimes without creating a second graph, with an optional P-118 durable resume boundary.

singleAuthority.rule: Runtime adapters consume the same DAG and may not define runtime-specific stage order, dependencies, waves, or merge authority.

durableExtension.claimBoundary: Every ready node, including the local merge node, is claimed before execution.
durableExtension.terminalCommitFailure: A rejected complete/fail commit becomes a structured durable_terminal_commit_failed node result; it may not escape as a raw batch rejection or remain bridge-completed.
durableExtension.leaseBoundary: Claims carry owner, expiry, attempt identity, heartbeat, and monotonically increasing fencing token.
durableExtension.activeLeaseResume: Resume detects every unexpired active claim before invoking work and returns blocked_until_lease_expiry with the blocking lease identity.
durableExtension.heartbeatFailure: Heartbeat errors are captured on the node record; stopping heartbeat never skips the terminal commit, whose active owner/attempt/fence/lease check remains authoritative.
durableExtension.resumeBoundary: Restore completed node outputs into bridge nodeRecords and workerResults, then schedule only incomplete nodes.
durableExtension.traversedEdgeBoundary: Every completed node atomically commits its actual DAG dependsOn edges with stable traversal and condition digests; resumed completed nodes do not write those edges again.
durableExtension.mergeBoundary: The local merge node consumes only its direct DAG dependency results.
durableExtension.externalEffects: Still forbidden by this read-only bridge; durable effect reconciliation remains owned by the kernel.

safety.codex: codex exec with ephemeral session, ignored user config/rules, and read-only sandbox
safety.claude: claude print mode with safe mode, plan permission mode, explicit read/search tools, and no session persistence
safety.childEnvironmentBoundary: Pass system variables plus an exact runtime allowlist: Codex receives only CODEX_HOME and named OPENAI endpoint/auth selectors; Claude receives only CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and named ANTHROPIC/Claude auth selectors. Prefix-matching is forbidden, parent session markers are removed, and unrelated project or cloud credentials are not inherited.
safety.filesystemReadBoundary: Provider sandbox/permission mode is read-only. Workspace-only reads are requested by prompt but are not claimed as mechanically confined by this bridge.
safety.telemetryRedaction: Before any durable retention, bound output and redact workspace/user-home paths, known secret environment values, and common KEY/TOKEN/PASSWORD/SECRET/CREDENTIAL fields from output, stderr, and failure text for built-in and custom invokers.
safety.nodeEffectBoundary: A worker node must itself declare read_only*, merge_only, or stage_control. Task-packet side-effect flags cannot downgrade a mutating node into read-only execution.
safety.timeoutMeaning: A process safety fuse only; it is not a token, cost, or task-performance budget.

requiredNodeEvidence: completed read/search tool event for file-based acceptance tasks
